01
Land, Settle, First Sunset
Arrival Day · Easy Evening
Canggu ▾
Afternoon
Touch down at Ngurah Rai Airport
2 × Toyota Hiace AC vans with English-speaking drivers waiting — straight to Nara Villa, Pererenan
Villa check-in, first swim in the private pool
Evening
Sunset drinks at FINS Beach Club (arrive 5:30pm)
Dinner at Billy Ho — Canggu's most iconic restaurant, Chinese-Indo fusion in a converted 70s house
Night
Warm-up drinks at Old Man's — the OG Canggu surf bar
Easy night — big days ahead
✦ Airport Transfer ✦ Private Nara Villa ★ FINS Beach Club (own cost) ★ Billy Ho Dinner (own cost)
02
Surf, ATLAS, Send It
The Big Canggu Day
Canggu ▾
Morning
Slow villa morning — pool, no alarm
Group surf lesson at Batu Bolong Beach (9am) — 10 boards, 10 instructors, everyone catches a wave
Breakfast at Crate Cafe — acai bowls, flat whites
Afternoon
ATLAS Beach Fest from 2pm — Bali's biggest and most spectacular beach club
Massive infinity pool · multiple bars · DJ from 3pm · stay until 7pm
Night
Quick villa reset, dinner at Masons
Old Man's → MissFish (Canggu's biggest club, bottle service available) → GreenDoor after midnight
The big Canggu night 🎉
✦ Group Surf Lesson ★ ATLAS Beach Fest (own cost) ★ MissFish Nightclub (own cost)
03
Clifftops, Fire & the Sea
Uluwatu Day · Temple Night
Uluwatu ▾
Morning
Slow villa morning — non-negotiable after last night
Both drivers leave for Uluwatu at 12pm (55 min drive south)
Afternoon
Savaya Beach Club from 1pm — group daybed booking
25m infinity pool on the cliff edge · DJ builds from 2pm · peaks at 4:30pm
Bali's most cinematic beach club. Leave by 4:30pm sharp.
Evening
Uluwatu Temple at 5pm — Kecak Fire Dance at 6pm
150 men chanting, fire lit, the Ramayana above the Indian Ocean at sunset
Seafood dinner at Jimbaran Beach — tables on the sand, grilled snapper and prawns by candlelight
✦ Kecak Fire Dance Tickets (10 pax) 🍽 Jimbaran Seafood Dinner — Included ★ Savaya Beach Club (own cost)
04
ATV Jungle → The Island
Ubud Morning · Nusa Penida Night
Ubud → Nusa Penida ▾
Morning
Leave Canggu 7:30am → drive to Tegalalang, Ubud (1hr)
ATV ride — 2hrs through rice field paths, jungle trails, river crossings
Lunch at ATV base — Indonesian cuisine, included
Midday
Bali Swing at Alas Harum Bali — swings over the rice terrace valley
The iconic Bali shot — everyone gets their go
Drive to Sanur Harbour (45 min)
Afternoon / Night
3pm fast boat to Nusa Penida (45 min catamaran)
Local drivers waiting at Toyapakeh port
Check in at BB Resort & Spa, Nusa Penida
Fresh seafood dinner at a local warung — the quiet night of the trip
✦ ATV Adventure (2hrs) ✦ Bali Swing — Alas Harum ✦ Fast Boat to Nusa Penida 🍽 Lunch at ATV Base — Included
05
Wild Penida
Full Island Circuit · Nature Day
Nusa Penida ▾
Morning
8am start with local drivers
Kelingking Beach — the T-Rex cliff, Bali's most photographed viewpoint. 200m sheer drop into turquoise water.
Afternoon
Angel's Billabong — natural rock infinity pool draining into the ocean (low tide only)
Broken Beach — dramatic natural sea arch you walk the rim of
Lunch — Indonesian cuisine, included
Crystal Bay — clearest water in the Bali region, snorkelling, reef fish
Evening
Return to BB Resort by sunset
Dinner at resort or local warung
Early night — 5:30am tomorrow
✦ Kelingking Cliff Viewpoint ✦ Angel's Billabong ✦ Broken Beach ✦ Crystal Bay Snorkelling 🍽 Lunch — Included
06
Mantas at Dawn · Last Night
5:30am Snorkel → Final Big Night
Penida → Canggu ▾
Dawn (5:30am)
Boat to Manta Point — 40 min ride
In the water by 6:15am. Manta rays 3–4m wingspan gliding directly beneath you. Almost guaranteed.
Back to resort by 8:30am. Breakfast. Pack up.
Midday
10am fast boat back to Sanur
Both drivers transfer group to Canggu
Check in to final night stay. Afternoon: villa pool, relax.
Evening
Sunset at La Brisa — the most beautiful beach club in Canggu
Send-off dinner at WOODS — best restaurant in Canggu
Final night: MissFish again or Vault (underground techno) — wherever the group takes it
✦ Manta Point Snorkel Boat ✦ Fast Boat Return to Sanur ★ La Brisa Sundowner (own cost) ★ WOODS Farewell Dinner (own cost)
07
Until Next Time
Slow Morning · Departure
Departure ▾
Morning
No alarm. Last villa pool morning.
Gojek breakfast delivery or walk to a local cafe
Pack, checkout
Transfer
Both Toyota Hiace AC vans to Ngurah Rai International Airport
Leave 3 hours before international departure (Canggu → Airport is 35–50 min)
The Takeaway
Kelingking cliff. Manta rays at 6am. Kecak fire at dusk. Savaya pool. A villa that became home for a week.
The kind of trip that changes the group chat name. 🏝

Where You Sleep

Private Villas,
Not Hotel Rooms

The whole group under one roof. Private pools, shared living, your own piece of Bali — no lobby, no corridors, no strangers.

Canggu · Nights 1, 2 & 3
Nara Villa
5-Bedroom Private Pool Villa · Pererenan

Modern luxury villa with a 20m private pool, full outdoor living, and ensuite rooms for the whole group. The kind of place you won't want to leave in the morning.

▶ Watch Villa Tour
Nusa Penida · Nights 4 & 5
BB Resort & Spa
Private Pool Villas · Nusa Penida

Traditional teak-and-thatch architecture buried in Penida's jungle. Private pools, island isolation, wake up to birdsong and palm trees. Zero Canggu energy — that's the point.
